[FACT] User is looking for new healthy snack ideas to keep on track with their goals.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Healthy snacking is a great way to stay on track with goals.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggestions for healthy snacks include fresh fruits, veggie delights, nuts and seeds, protein-packed options, whole grain goodness, healthy granola, and other healthy options.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Fresh fruits suggestions: seasonal fruits like apples, bananas, or oranges; berries with Greek yogurt; citrus fruits with cinnamon.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Veggie delights suggestions: carrot sticks with hummus; cucumber slices with dill dip; cherry tomatoes with balsamic vinegar and basil; roasted chickpeas seasoned with herbs and spices.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Nuts and seeds suggestions: almonds or walnuts; trail mix with nuts, seeds, and dried fruits; chia seeds or flaxseeds; pumpkin seeds roasted with olive oil and salt.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Protein-packed suggestions: hard-boiled eggs; Greek yogurt with honey and nuts; cottage cheese with fruit or cucumber slices; edamame or roasted chickpeas.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Whole grain goodness suggestions: whole grain crackers with avocado or peanut butter; oatmeal with fruit and nuts; whole grain toast with almond butter and banana slices; air-popped popcorn seasoned with herbs and spices.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Healthy granola suggestions: homemade granola with nuts, seeds, and dried fruits; store-bought granola with Greek yogurt and berries; energy balls made with oats, nuts, and dried fruits.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Other healthy options: smoothies made with frozen fruits, yogurt, and milk; infused water with fruits, herbs, or cucumber; dark chocolate (70% cocoa or higher) in moderation; apple slices with almond butter or peanut butter.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Portion control is key, and it's essential to choose snacks that fit dietary needs and preferences.
